topic.title: Git Client Add-on
topic.shortdesc: The Git Client add-on integrates a full Git client into , enabling you to commit, push, pull, branch, and resolve conflicts without leaving the editor.

body.note:
This add-on is compatible with the following products:
Oxygen XML Editor
Oxygen XML Author
Oxygen XML Developer
Oxygen JSON Editor
body.p: The Git Client adds a built-in Git client to . After you install the it, you can use the top-level Git menu, three dedicated views, a preferences page, and contextual Git actions in other views and editors.

The following sections guide you through the Git Client in a more task-oriented order. First install the add-on, get oriented in the interface, and set up a repository. Then review and commit local changes, synchronize with remote repositories, resolve conflicts when they occur, work with branches and tags, and review history and commits. After the main workflow topics, the advanced, configuration, interface reference, and actions reference sections provide more detailed lookup information.

The Git Client add-on works with a selected Git working copy. It helps you move from orientation and repository setup into daily change review, synchronization, branch work, conflict resolution, and history review without leaving .
